newsitem.title: USA: Lyondell's Houston FCC seen at 75-80 pct on Sat.
newsitem.headline: Lyondell's Houston FCC seen at 75-80 pct on Sat.

text.p: Lyondell Petrochemical Corp is expected have its 96,000 barrel-per-day fluid catalytic cracker back up to 75 to 80 percent of its 96,000 barrel per day capacity on Saturday, a company source said Friday.
"It's going to take a couple of days. We'll have the bulk of it up tomorrow, around 75 to 80 percent," the source said.
The company has lost an estimated 200,000 barrels of gasoline production as a result of outage.
The company pulled the unit off line on Tuesday after it discovered there may have been a problem with a compressor in the cracker, and has said it was largely a precautionary measure.
The company began the restarting procedure, which can be a an extended process, on Wednesday.
